base: clean rebuild from original NASA source
release: Clean Night Lights Rebuild — 85% C structure / 15% D finish
source: NASA Black Marble 2016 historical colour composite
signalSampling: 60% centre + 40% local 75th percentile over 9 samples at +/-0.30 destination pixel

visualTarget.interpretation: Option C defines signal structure and sharpness; Option D only contributes restrained warm-gold micro-glow.

markerMethod: direct inverse lookup on reference-coordinates-v127 field
